MINOR: `TestAuthorityFailureMetricUsesBoundedReasons` duplicates the allowed reason allowlist locally instead of reusing a production/exported constant, so any future bounded reason addition requires lockstep test edits and can drift from the real gauge contract.

The bounded-label loop never asserts that at least one `edp_backlog_authority_errors_total{reason="..."}` line was emitted; if the metric name/label changed or emission regressed, the cardinality assertion would pass vacuously.
NIT: Removing the old `strings.Contains(err.Error(), "57014")` fallback means a non-`*pgconn.PgError` wrapper that only preserves SQLSTATE text and lacks the "statement timeout" marker will now classify as `db_unavailable` rather than `timeout`; acceptable if all authority DB errors stay structured, but worth pinning with a wrapped-error case.
SUMMARY: Delta is directionally correct: pgx is promoted to a direct dependency, reason classification now uses structured `pgconn.PgError`, and cardinality assertions were added. Prior MAJOR/MINOR/NIT findings appear actioned.
Remaining gaps are test-quality/maintainability issues around duplicated allowlist and vacuous label assertions, not runtime correctness or AC regressions in this delta.
